overview.zh: 前沿AI以超大规模融资与能力披露加速入场，加密行业则把重心转向基础设施与制度博弈。 AI资本化：Anthropic招股书披露1.5万亿美元预期估值，位列IPO史第三，并计划未来数年投入2656亿美元算力支出。 加密基础设施：ENSv2上线以太坊主网，引入分层注册表与分区权限模型，现有.eth域名无需重新注册。 监管与政治：CFTC起诉犹他州以阻止其对预测市场执法，加密行业本周期已投入约1.76亿美元支持中期选举盟友。
overview.en: Frontier AI moves toward mega-scale public markets and disclosed offensive capability, while crypto shifts to infrastructure and institutional politics. AI capital scale：Anthropic's prospectus cites a $1.5 trillion expected valuation, third-largest IPO on record, and $265.6 billion in planned compute spending. Crypto infrastructure：ENSv2 launched on Ethereum mainnet with hierarchical registries and zone-based permissions; existing .eth names need no re-registration. Regulation and politics：The CFTC sued Utah to block prediction-market enforcement, as crypto spent about $176 million backing midterm allies this cycle.

title.zh: Anthropic 在多项指标上超越史上大多数 IPO
title.en: Anthropic outranks most IPOs in history

summary.zh:
Anthropic 于周一提交的 IPO 招股书披露，其预期估值达 1.5 万亿美元，在 IPO 史上位列第三，仅次于沙特阿美的 1.7 万亿美元和 SpaceX 的 1.8 万亿美元；同时披露的还有六个月 1300% 的营收增长和第二季度 663 亿美元的亏损。公司称，该亏损主要来自与估值上升相关的可转换债券重新定价。

这份招股书为外界提供了前沿 AI 实验室少见的详细财务披露，涵盖营收留存率、算力采购承诺和累计亏损等在私营 AI 公司中通常不公开的数据，而此次上市也可能跻身史上规模最大的 IPO 之列。

Anthropic 披露的净营收留存率约为 900%，但其统计口径包含全年仅支付 1 美元的客户，并将 Pro 和 Max 订阅用户排除在外。公司还预计未来几年将在算力服务上支出 2656 亿美元，并在招股书中警告不预期营收会以相近速度持续增长；另有媒体在报道该文件时给出的上半年净亏损数字在 800 亿美元左右。
summary.en:
Anthropic's IPO prospectus, filed on Monday, discloses an expected $1.5 trillion valuation — third-largest in IPO history behind Saudi Aramco's $1.7 trillion and SpaceX's $1.8 trillion — alongside 1,300% six-month revenue growth and a $66.3 billion second-quarter loss. The company says the loss is largely attributable to repriced convertible debt tied to its rising enterprise valuation.

The filing provides unusually detailed financial disclosure from a frontier AI lab ahead of what would be one of the largest listings on record, including revenue retention, compute commitments and accumulated deficit figures that are rarely visible for private AI developers.

Anthropic reports roughly 900% net revenue retention, but its definition includes customers who paid as little as $1 over a year and excludes Pro and Max subscribers. It also expects to spend $265.6 billion on computational services over the next few years and warns in the filing that it does not expect revenue to keep growing at comparable rates; other coverage of the filing has cited first-half net loss figures in the $80 billion range.

title.en: ENSv2 Officially Launches on Ethereum Mainnet

summary.zh:
10 月 27 日，ENSv2 正式上线以太坊主网。新版本引入分层注册表与更精细的权限模型，单个域名可作为独立的链上注册表，社区和机构可自定义子域名发行规则并分区授权管理；同时更新了域名解析方式，支持记录链接共享，并配套推出面向普通用户的新版 ENS App 和面向开发者的 ENS Explorer。

ENS 表示，其生态目前共支持超过 3600 万个域名，覆盖 600 多个应用；官方称现有 .eth 域名将继续正常工作、无需重新注册，用户自即日起可在 ENS App 内自愿升级至 ENSv2。新的权限模型把子域名规则与所有权管理的控制权，从单一的全局注册表下放到各个域名所有者手中。

在升级全部合格域名后，用户可领取由艺术家 Polyhop 设计的 ENSv2 纪念 NFT，每个钱包一枚，需支付以太坊网络 Gas 费。1inch、MetaMask、Safe、Uniswap、PayPal、Venmo、OpenSea 等应用已在适配 ENSv2。
summary.en:
ENSv2 went live on the Ethereum mainnet on October 27, introducing hierarchical registries and a more granular permission model under which a single name can act as an independent on-chain registry, letting communities and organizations define their own subdomain issuance rules and delegate management by zone. The release also updates how names are resolved, adds support for shared record links, and ships a new ENS App for general users plus an ENS Explorer for developers.

ENS says its ecosystem now covers more than 36 million domains across over 600 applications, and that existing .eth domains will continue to work without re-registration, with users able to voluntarily upgrade to ENSv2 in the ENS App starting today. The permission changes shift control over subdomain rules and ownership management from a single global registry to individual name owners.

After upgrading all eligible domains, users can claim a commemorative ENSv2 NFT designed by artist Polyhop, one per wallet, subject to Ethereum network gas fees. 1inch, MetaMask, Safe, Uniswap, PayPal, Venmo and OpenSea are among the applications already adapting to ENSv2.

title.zh: 前沿AI实验室称其模型证伪了指数时间假说，这意味着什么？
title.en: Frontier AI labs say their models refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis. What does that mean?

summary.zh:
TechCrunch 刊发了一篇对麻省理工学院（MIT）计算机科学家的采访，主题是 OpenAI 声称其模型给出了对指数时间假说（ETH）的证伪。该假说是计算复杂性理论中一个尚未被证明的困难性假设。这篇文章是对该主张的解释性访谈，而非证明本身，也不构成独立验证。

ETH 是大量关于可满足性问题困难性以及参数化算法研究的基础，因此若证伪成立，许多以该假说为前提的结论将受到动摇。《新科学家》报道称，若该结果得到确认，计算机科学教科书将不得不重写。

由 Impagliazzo 与 Paturi 提出的 ETH 断言：3-CNF 布尔公式的可满足性问题无法在次指数时间内求解；其更强形式 SETH 则认为，随着子句宽度增长，k-SAT 的二进制极限指数趋于 1。报道还提到，OpenAI 公布了大量由 AI 生成的数学结果，其中仅有一部分经过机器验证，数学家表示目前几乎没有人能理解这些结果。
summary.en:
TechCrunch published an interview with an MIT computer scientist about OpenAI's claim that its models produced a refutation of the Exponential Time Hypothesis (ETH), an unproven hardness assumption in computational complexity theory. The piece is an explanatory interview about the claim rather than the underlying proof or an independent verification of it.

ETH underpins a large body of work on the hardness of satisfiability and on parameterized algorithms, so a valid refutation would unsettle results that assume it. New Scientist reported that, if confirmed, the result would force computer-science textbooks to be rewritten.

ETH, formulated by Impagliazzo and Paturi, states that satisfiability of 3-CNF Boolean formulas cannot be solved in subexponential time; its stronger variant, SETH, asserts that the limiting base-two exponent for k-SAT tends to one as clause width grows. Reports also note that OpenAI has posted a large batch of AI-generated math results of which only a portion has been machine-checked, and that mathematicians say few people understand them yet.

title.zh: Robinhood第三季度营收符合预期，预测市场收入激增而加密收入下降55%
title.en: Robinhood Q3 Revenue Meets Estimates as Prediction Market Revenue Surges and Cry

summary.zh:
Robinhood公布2026年第三季度营收14.24亿美元，同比增长12%，与14.2亿美元的市场预期基本一致；但摊薄每股收益0.51美元，低于0.56美元的预期。预测市场事件合约收入增长逾六倍至1.73亿美元，而加密交易收入下降55%至1.2亿美元。

本季度事件合约收入1.73亿美元已超过加密交易收入1.2亿美元，显示公司收入结构正从加密现货交易向事件合约倾斜。Robinhood同时将2026年调整后运营费用与股权激励指引上限从27.75亿美元下调至27.5亿美元，下限维持在26.75亿美元。

加密名义交易量下降38%至500亿美元，而事件合约交易量增长逾七倍至164亿份。Robinhood Chain在主网运行的首个季度录得逾800亿美元DEX交易量和超过5000万美元网络费用；净利润下降14%至4.76亿美元，调整后EBITDA增长9%至8.08亿美元，每股收益中包含主要与Robinhood Ventures Fund I相关的每股0.07美元未实现亏损。
summary.en:
Robinhood reported Q3 2026 revenue of $1.424 billion, up 12% year-over-year and roughly in line with the $1.42 billion estimate, while diluted EPS of $0.51 missed the $0.56 estimate. Prediction-market event contract revenue rose more than sixfold to $173 million, while crypto transaction revenue fell 55% to $120 million.

Event contract revenue of $173 million exceeded crypto transaction revenue of $120 million in the quarter, a shift in the company's revenue mix away from spot crypto trading. Robinhood also lowered the upper end of its 2026 adjusted operating expense and stock-based compensation outlook to $2.75 billion from $2.775 billion, keeping the low end at $2.675 billion.

Crypto notional trading volume fell 38% to $50 billion, while event contracts traded rose more than sevenfold to 16.4 billion. Robinhood Chain recorded over $80 billion in DEX trading volume and more than $50 million in network fees in its first quarter on mainnet; net income fell 14% to $476 million and adjusted EBITDA rose 9% to $808 million, with EPS including $0.07 per share of unrealized losses primarily tied to Robinhood Ventures Fund I.

title.zh: 比特币钱包厂商 Keystone 停售设备：工厂密钥被盗为仿冒品打开大门
title.en: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Keystone Pulls Devices as Stolen Key Opens Door to Fakes

summary.zh:
Keystone 周一表示，将销毁 18,835 台未售出的硬件钱包，并暂停所有官网未发货订单的配送，原因是攻击者获取了其设备用于验证真伪的永久性工厂 WebAuth 密钥。该事件于 10 月 20 日被发现，同时泄露了其 Shopify 商店中 25,964 条 2024 年至 2026 年的买家记录，包括姓名、联系方式、收货地址和订单信息。

由于被盗密钥正是 Keystone 官网验证页面所依赖的凭据，仿冒设备可能通过真伪校验并被卖给用户，而用户可能在其上存入真实资产；Keystone 表示这类设备可能被当作正品 unknowingly 使用，“可能导致资产被盗”。该公司称助记词和私钥未受影响，10 月 20 日之前交付的设备不受影响。

Keystone 称共涉及 51,083 条买家记录，但其中 25,119 条的个人信息已被清除，剩余 25,964 条仍保留数据——公司将这一保留超期归因于自动批量删除任务失败且未被及时发现，违背了其 180 天删除政策。通过亚马逊及其他渠道的购买未受影响；在采用新密钥的设备投产前，官网销售将转为预售，Keystone 表示已向欧盟、英国等司法辖区的有关部门提交报告，并提醒任何以“召回”为名要求用户寄回设备的人都是骗子。
summary.en:
Keystone said Monday it will destroy 18,835 unsold hardware wallets and has suspended shipping of all unshipped website orders after an attacker obtained the permanent factory WebAuth key its devices use to prove they are genuine. The breach, detected October 20, also exposed 25,964 buyer records from Keystone's Shopify store covering 2024 to 2026, including names, contact details, shipping addresses and order information.

Because the stolen key is what Keystone's own verification page relies on, counterfeit devices could pass the authenticity check and be sold to users who load real savings onto them; Keystone said such devices could be used unknowingly as genuine products, "potentially resulting in asset theft." The company says recovery phrases and private keys were not involved and that devices delivered before October 20 are unaffected.

Keystone says 51,083 buyer records were involved in total, but 25,119 had already had personal information erased, leaving 25,964 records that still held data — a retention failure the company attributed to automated bulk-deletion tasks that failed without being detected in time against its 180-day erasure policy. Purchases through Amazon and other channels were not affected; website sales will switch to preorders until devices with a new key are produced, and Keystone says it has filed reports with authorities in the EU, UK and other jurisdictions while warning that anyone claiming to run a "recall" and asking users to ship back devices is a scammer.

title.zh: Gamdom遭勒索组织Whitearmor索要1500万美元比特币赎金
title.en: Gamdom hit by Whitearmor ransomware group demanding $15 million in bitcoin

summary.zh:
据 BlockBeats 10 月 27 日报道，网络勒索组织 Whitearmor 声称掌握包含 15,420,003 个 Gamdom 客户账户的数据库，并要求支付价值 1500 万美元的比特币以阻止数据被公开。该组织在其勒索网站上公布了 Gamdom 的相关信息，并发布了一份约 437 KB、包含约 100 条记录的 JSON 样本文件作为证据，声称可访问每个账户的 146 个数据字段。

若该说法属实，涉及的是一个加密货币博彩平台上超过 1500 万个账户的用户数据，但这一说法目前仅来自勒索组织自身。此次勒索发生在 Gamdom 尚未从早前数百万美元热钱包被盗事件中完全恢复之际。

据报道，攻击者据称通过一台老旧的内部机器账户实施入侵，该账户凭证从未轮换更新，尽管创建已久仍保留管理员权限。1540 万账户这一数字及样本文件均来自 Whitearmor 单方面说法，尚未获得独立核实。
summary.en:
Ransomware group Whitearmor claims to hold a database of 15,420,003 Gamdom customer accounts and is demanding $15 million in bitcoin to keep it from being published, according to a BlockBeats report on October 27. The group posted Gamdom's information on its leak site and released a roughly 437 KB JSON sample containing about 100 records as evidence, claiming it can access 146 data fields for each account.

If the claim is accurate, the exposure would cover a user base of more than 15 million accounts tied to a crypto gambling platform, according to the group's own assertion. The demand comes as Gamdom says it has not fully recovered from an earlier theft of millions of dollars from its hot wallet.

According to the report, the attackers allegedly gained access through an old internal machine account whose credentials were never rotated, leaving it with administrator privileges despite having been created long ago. The 15.4 million figure and the data sample come from Whitearmor's own claims and have not been independently verified.

title.zh: 币安拦截多起与朝鲜相关的网络攻击，未造成资产损失
title.en: Binance Blocks Multiple North Korea-Linked Cyberattacks With No Asset Losses

summary.zh:
据 Hokanews 报道，币安拦截了多起与朝鲜相关、针对其平台的网络攻击尝试，未报告任何资产损失。

大型交易所仍是与朝鲜相关的入侵行动的主要目标，而此次报道的结果是攻击尝试被阻断，而非客户资金受损。

报道将这些攻击尝试归因于与朝鲜有关的攻击方，并称未造成资产损失。
summary.en:
Binance blocked multiple cyberattack attempts linked to North Korea targeting its platform, with no asset losses reported, according to Hokanews.

Major exchanges remain a primary target for North Korea-linked intrusion campaigns, and the reported outcome here was disruption of the attempts rather than loss of customer funds.

The report attributes the attempts to North Korea-linked actors and states that no assets were lost.

title.zh: 【Ripple 扩大与纽约银行在托管和代币化贸易融资领域的战略合作】
title.en: Ripple Expands Strategic Partnership with BNY in Custody and Tokenized Trade Finance

summary.zh:
Ripple 扩大与纽约银行（BNY）的战略合作，旨在拓展机构数字资产托管能力，并探索区块链技术在机构领域的新应用场景，包括代币化贸易融资。此次合作将 Ripple 的数字资产解决方案和公共区块链 XRP Ledger 与 BNY 的规模、服务模式和数字化能力相结合。

这一安排将大型托管银行与公共区块链网络结合，扩展了机构数字资产托管范围，并推动代币化贸易融资向商业测试阶段迈进。BNY 自身的分析认为，随着法律框架与区块链创新的推进，代币化贸易融资正逐步接近商业现实。

Ripple 与 BNY 表示，双方计划在 XRP Ledger 上推进代币化贸易融资，具体取决于客户需求。代币化贸易融资将应收账款等既有贸易融资资产以数字形式表示，有望扩大投资者参与范围，并简化相关资产的管理与分销方式。
summary.en:
Ripple has expanded its strategic partnership with the Bank of New York Mellon (BNY) to broaden institutional digital asset custody capabilities and to explore new institutional use cases for blockchain technology, including tokenized trade finance. The collaboration combines Ripple's digital asset solutions and the public XRP Ledger with BNY's scale, service model and digital capabilities.

The arrangement pairs a major custodian bank with a public blockchain network, extending institutional digital asset custody and moving tokenized trade finance toward commercial testing. BNY's own commentary describes tokenized trade finance as edging closer to commercial reality as legal frameworks and blockchain innovation develop.

Ripple and BNY said they intend to advance tokenized trade finance on the XRPL, subject to client requirements. Tokenized trade finance digitally represents existing trade finance assets such as receivables, which can broaden investor access and simplify how those assets are managed and distributed.

title.zh: Janus Henderson将推出首只追踪纳斯达克100指数的代币化基金JQQQ
title.en: Janus Henderson to Launch JQQQ, the First Tokenized Fund Tracking the Nasdaq 100

summary.zh:
据《华尔街日报》报道，Janus Henderson 宣布将推出 JQQQ，并称这是首只获得纳斯达克 100 指数授权的代币化基金；该基金采用 Centrifuge 的代币化基础设施，部署在 Stellar 区块链上。基金初期面向美国境外的合格专业投资者开放，最低投资金额为 10 万美元。

此举将 Janus Henderson 的链上产品从美国国债和结构化信贷扩展至股票指数敞口；该资产管理公司称，其机构链上策略规模已超过 10 亿美元。

JQQQ 是设立于英属维尔京群岛的投资公司旗下的独立投资组合，提供对纳斯达克 100 指数的间接敞口，而非持有成分股。该基金依据与纳斯达克签署的授权协议运作。
summary.en:
Janus Henderson announced it will launch JQQQ, billed as the first licensed tokenized fund tracking the Nasdaq 100, built with Centrifuge's tokenization infrastructure and deployed on the Stellar blockchain, according to a Wall Street Journal report. The fund will initially be open to eligible professional investors outside the United States, with a minimum investment of $100,000.

The launch extends Janus Henderson's onchain products beyond US Treasurys and structured credit into equity-index exposure; the asset manager said its institutional onchain strategies now exceed $1 billion.

JQQQ is structured as a segregated portfolio of a British Virgin Islands investment company and provides indirect exposure to the Nasdaq 100 rather than ownership of the underlying stocks. The fund operates under a licensing agreement with Nasdaq.

title.zh: 利用 Claude 发现并利用关键真实世界软件中的漏洞
title.en: Discovering and exploiting vulnerabilities in critical, real-world software with Claude - Anthropic

summary.zh:
Anthropic 发布了一份详细说明，介绍其 Claude 模型如何被用于发现并利用广泛部署的关键真实世界软件中的漏洞。该文章将结果呈现为 AI 安全工具防御潜力的证据，同时也视为其双用途风险的体现。

一家头部 AI 实验室公开记录其自有模型取得的具体攻击性能力结果，为安全团队与政策制定者提供了一个参照，说明 AI 正在压缩漏洞发现与利用之间的时间差——谷歌威胁情报团队也指出了这一变化。

该披露涉及的是广泛部署的关键软件，而非孤立的测试目标，Anthropic 明确以双用途风险为框架来阐述这项工作。这份材料属于研究与安全披露，而非产品发布。
summary.en:
Anthropic published a detailed account of how its Claude models were used to discover and exploit vulnerabilities in critical, widely deployed real-world software. The write-up presents the results as evidence of both the defensive potential of AI security tooling and the dual-use risk it carries.

A leading AI lab publicly documenting concrete offensive-capability results with its own model gives security teams and policymakers a reference point for how AI is compressing the interval between vulnerability discovery and exploitation — a shift Google's threat intelligence group has also flagged.

The disclosure covers critical, widely deployed software rather than isolated test targets, and Anthropic frames the work explicitly around dual-use risk. The material is a research and safety write-up, not a product release.

title.zh: 深度：加密行业豪掷1.76亿美元支持盟友冲击中期选举，为“后特朗普时代”布局
title.en: Insight: Crypto blitzes midterms with $176 million to support allies as it prepares for post-Trump era

summary.zh:
据路透社报道，加密货币行业在本届选举周期已在100多场美国中期选举中投入约1.76亿美元，用于支持对行业友好的候选人，由Coinbase、Ripple和a16z等支持的超级政治行动委员会Fairshake主导了这笔投入。报道称，Fairshake支持的58名初选或特别选举候选人中已有53人晋级。

报道称，这是行业多年计划的一部分，目的是在国会建立一个跨党派的盟友联盟，以便在特朗普卸任后继续在华盛顿推进其政策诉求。

该策略聚焦于挑选胜选可能性较高的候选人，并通过关联政治行动委员会投放广告，广告内容往往并不直接提及加密。路透社将该布局描述为对“后特朗普政策环境”的准备，而非一次性的选举投入。
summary.en:
The crypto industry has spent roughly $176 million across more than 100 US midterm races this cycle to back friendly candidates, Reuters reported, with the Fairshake super PAC — supported by Coinbase, Ripple and a16z — leading the effort. Of the 58 primary or special election candidates Fairshake backed, 53 advanced, according to the report.

The spending is described as part of a multi-year plan to build a bipartisan bloc of congressional allies so the industry can keep advancing its priorities in Washington after Trump leaves office.

The strategy focuses on candidates judged to have strong odds of winning, with affiliated PACs running advertisements that often do not mention crypto directly. Reuters framed the effort as preparation for a post-Trump policy environment rather than a single-election push.

title.zh: CFTC起诉犹他州，试图阻止其对预测市场的执法
title.en: CFTC Sues Utah to Block Prediction-Market Enforcement

summary.zh:
美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）向美国犹他州联邦地区法院提起诉讼，起诉犹他州及该州总检察长德里克·布朗（Derek Brown），试图阻止该州对预测市场运营方展开执法。该诉讼于周一提交，而一周前犹他州刚宣布对Kalshi及其关联公司采取法律行动，要求追回其声称非法获得的至多6000万美元利润。

这起诉讼直接争讼各州能否对CFTC已批准的平台上适用本州博彩法。Kalshi发言人杰基·麦加维克（Jacki McGavick）表示，不应由任何单一州对受CFTC监管的全国性衍生品市场拥有否决权。CFTC则主张，犹他州的行动侵犯了国会为商品衍生品市场设计的专属联邦监管体系。

CFTC在诉状中称，犹他州所针对的事件合约属于《商品交易法》下的“互换”（swaps），提供这些合约的交易所是受CFTC监管的指定合约市场（DCM）。该机构主张，犹他州试图阻止受CFTC监管的指定合约市场提供经CFTC批准的产品，绕过了国会以联邦法优先于州法的立法意图。
summary.en:
The US Commodity Futures Trading Commission filed suit in the US District Court for the District of Utah against the State of Utah and Attorney General Derek Brown, seeking to block state enforcement against prediction-market operators. The Monday filing came a week after Utah announced legal action against Kalshi and its affiliates to recover up to $60 million in profits it alleges were obtained illegally.

The suit directly contests whether a state may apply its gambling laws to platforms the CFTC has authorized, and a Kalshi spokesperson, Jacki McGavick, said no single state should have a veto over a national derivatives market overseen by the CFTC. The CFTC argues that Utah's action intrudes on what it calls Congress's exclusive federal scheme for commodity derivatives.

The CFTC's complaint states that the event contracts targeted by Utah are "swaps" under the Commodity Exchange Act and that the exchanges offering them are CFTC-regulated Designated Contract Markets. It argues Utah's efforts to stop a CFTC-regulated DCM from offering CFTC-approved products bypass congressional intent to federally preempt state law.

title.zh: Anchorage 布局美墨稳定币走廊，力图成为托管支柱
title.en: Anchorage Positions Itself as Custody Backbone of US-Mexico Stablecoin Corridor

summary.zh:
Anchorage Digital 于周二宣布扩大与 Bitso 的托管与上币安排：Anchorage Digital Bank 现已在 Arbitrum、Base、Ethereum、Polygon、Avalanche 和 Arc 六条区块链上托管 Bitso 的墨西哥比索稳定币 MXNB。Bitso 则相应上线了 USDPT 与 USAT，这两款分别来自 Western Union 和 Tether 的美元稳定币由 Anchorage 发行并托管。双方未披露财务条款。

该安排让一家获得联邦牌照的加密银行同时覆盖这条每年转移数百亿美元汇款通道的两端，而其中约 15% 的资金已通过 Bitso 的基础设施流转。Anchorage 首席执行官 Nathan McCauley 称，这条走廊正是“稳定币不再只是论点、而是开始规模化转移真实资金”的地方。

Bitso 稳定币负责人 Ben Reid 表示，客户现在可以在完全链上的环境中使用完整的美元—比索通道，并由一家联邦牌照银行提供支撑。这条走廊的很大一部分资金目前仍通过代理行、电汇和现金取款网络流转。
summary.en:
Anchorage Digital expanded its custody-and-listing arrangement with Bitso, announced Tuesday, so that Anchorage Digital Bank now custodies MXNB — Bitso's Mexican peso stablecoin — across six blockchains: Arbitrum, Base, Ethereum, Polygon, Avalanche and Arc. Bitso, in turn, has listed USDPT and USAT, the U.S. dollar stablecoins from Western Union and Tether that Anchorage issues and custodies. Financial terms were not disclosed.

The arrangement places a federally chartered crypto bank beneath both ends of a remittance route that moves tens of billions of dollars a year, with roughly 15% already running through Bitso's infrastructure. Anchorage CEO Nathan McCauley said the corridor is "where stablecoins stop being a thesis and start moving real money at scale."

Bitso's head of stablecoin Ben Reid said clients can now access the full dollar-peso corridor fully onchain, backed by a federally chartered bank. Much of the corridor's volume still moves through correspondent banking, wire transfers and cash-pickup networks.

title.zh: 闪电网络在据报攻击致比特币提现显示为未支付后收紧发票规则
title.en: Lightning tightens invoice rules after reported attack made Bitcoin withdrawals look unpaid

summary.zh:
闪电网络开发者于10月19日收紧了其发票标准 BOLT11，要求软件拒绝包含含糊、缺失或重复的支付哈希（payment hash）与支付密钥（payment secret）字段的发票。此举源于一名开发者披露的一起攻击事件：该攻击使已完成的比特币提现显示为未支付。

支付哈希或支付密钥字段存在歧义的发票，可能让已完成的支付被呈现为未支付；要求各实现拒绝此类发票，便在协议标准层面消除了这一歧义。

该修改已被合并进 BOLT11——闪电网络钱包和节点用来编码支付请求（包含目标节点、金额、支付哈希和有效期）的发票规范。相关事件源自一名开发者的描述，尚未被确认为大规模漏洞利用。
summary.en:
Lightning developers tightened BOLT11, the Lightning Network's invoice standard, on Oct. 19, requiring software to reject invoices with ambiguous, missing or repeated payment-hash and payment-secret fields. The change follows a developer's account of an attack that made completed Bitcoin withdrawals appear unpaid.

Invoices with ambiguous payment-hash or payment-secret fields could let a completed payment be presented as unpaid, so requiring implementations to reject them removes that ambiguity at the protocol-standard level.

The change was merged into BOLT11, the invoice specification that Lightning wallets and nodes use to encode payment requests including the destination, amount, payment hash and expiry. The reported incident was described in a developer's account and has not been confirmed as a large-scale exploit.
